gloria-romero.text: Campaigns on universal school choice and accountability: "ZIP codes should not determine a child's future"; campaign materials tout support for vouchers.

gloria-romero.text: As a state senator, authored the "parent trigger" law letting a majority of parents at a "failing school" vote on a restructuring method; later founded Scholarship Prep Charter School.

Candidate statement: "California's budget is bloated with bureaucracy and waste"; cites failures in education, homelessness and public safety under one-party rule; pledges to defend parental rights in schools.
